summary: Task 5 test wiring is correct, focused, and passes all 15 tests in the affected files. Production wiring in news_bot.py (SOURCE_HASHTAG_OVERRIDE='#thunted', NETLOC_TO_SOURCE entry for t-hunted.blogspot.com, blogspot.com branch in fetch_full_article calling t_hunted_source.fetch_t_hunted_article) matches every assertion byte-for-byte. Tests honour the locked names, the exact #thunted/#thunted #news strings, and the AC requirement that the unknown-domain dispatcher branch returns None.

suggestions.suggestion: Optionally also assert the keyword argument: the dispatcher calls t_hunted_source.fetch_t_hunted_article(link, notifier=send_admin_notification). Locking notifier=ANY (or just asserting 'notifier' in mock_fetch.call_args.kwargs) would catch a regression that drops the notifier wiring while still passing the link assertion. The spec only requires the positional-arg + call_count + return-value assertions, so this is purely optional.
suggestions.benefit: Hardens guard against a future refactor that silently drops the notifier= keyword arg from the dispatcher branch.

suggestions.suggestion: test_fetch_full_article_unknown_domain_returns_none does not patch the five source-fetchers. If an unknown link were ever to accidentally match one of the substring checks (e.g., a future 'example.com' domain accidentally containing one of the registered substrings), the test could hit a real network call. Current 'unknown.example.com' is safe against today's branches, but defensively patching news_bot.fetch_mattel_article / lamley_source.fetch_lamley_article / autoevolution_source.fetch_autoevolution_article / t_hunted_source.fetch_t_hunted_article (and asserting call_count == 0 on each) would give the hard-guarantee the task spec describes as an acceptable variant.
suggestions.benefit: Eliminates any residual risk of accidental network traffic and gives the test a stronger 'no handler matched' assertion surface.

suggestions.suggestion: The sys.path hack (sys.path.insert with dirname/dirname/abspath) is duplicated across many test files in this project — including test_telegram.py — so it is consistent with surrounding style. No action required, but a conftest.py-level fix would remove the duplication project-wide. Out of scope for Task 5.
suggestions.benefit: DRY for path bootstrap across the whole test suite.
